acceptance_criteria.criterion: Settings form has a 'Capture dialogues' checkbox
Checkbox is pre-populated from the current capture_dialogues config value on page load
Toggling and saving the checkbox updates capture_dialogues in gui-config.json
A note below the checkbox reads: 'Captures full LLM conversations during orchestrator runs. Takes effect on next run.'
The checkbox follows the same HTML/JS pattern as auto_handoff_enabled
